Torah #91 is among the shortest teachings in Likutay Moharan — only 7 lines of text. The single bechina in the dataset is שמש ↔ חכמה ('the sun is a bechina of wisdom, as cited in Torah #1'). Rebbe Nachman explicitly cross-references Torah #1 for this identity. A second bechina is clearly present in the text (שמש = שכל, since 'עַד בֹּא הַשָּׁמֶשׁ — הַיְנוּ לְהַשֵּׂכֶל שֶׁל הַדָּבָר'), and a third is linguistically embedded in the verse interpretation (יָדָיו = אֱמוּנָה — 'his hands were faith'). These two implicit bechinas are treated as gap additions (see torah_91_additions.json). The single explicit bechina edge forms one package. No merges were required or possible. Torah #91's argument is a simple two-move arc: faith spreads through the body (including the hands) →eitza→ faith transforms into sekhel/chokhmah (the 'sun' that the verse says 'came').

packages.label: שֶׁמֶשׁ וְחָכְמָה — The Sun and Wisdom
packages.label_en: The Sun as the Dimension of Wisdom
packages.reason: Torah #91 is built on a single structural identity: שמש (the sun) IS a bechina of חכמה (wisdom/sekhel). This is not a cause-and-effect statement — it is an ontological equation. The verse 'עַד בֹּא הַשָּׁמֶשׁ' (until the sun came) is interpreted to mean 'until the sekhel of the matter [was reached],' and the ground for this interpretation is precisely that 'the sun is a bechina of chokhmah, as cited above [in Torah #1].' The sun and wisdom share the same essential nature: they are both the illuminating, penetrating, crowning light that dispels darkness and reveals what was hidden. The sun-wisdom identity is the destination-point of the Torah's entire argument: sustained faith (אמונה) that spreads through all the limbs is what carries a person 'until the sun comes' — i.e., until the level of chokhmah is attained. Both שמש and חכמה represent the same ontological reality: the highest light-dimension of consciousness, the illuminating sekhel that is the 'sun' of spiritual life. Polarity is good: this is the domain of holy wisdom, divine light, and intellectual attainment — the positive telos of the teaching.
